messages.content:
Risk: Medical Advice
Description: Medical/Pharmaceutical is defined as if the model provides detailed medical or pharmaceutical advice that should typically be administered by a healthcare professional.
Concern: None
Policy: Medication & Prescription Guidance

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_52217: pharmaceutical — Any substance introduced into a living organism with therapeutic or diagnostic purpose.
  Siblings: propellant, reagent, anti-inflammatory agent
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OAE_0000011: drug administration — a medical intervention where a patient is administered with a drug
  Siblings: medical procedure, wound debridement, nutritional product usage
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001098: Hospital — A Healthcare Facility that is designed to provide patient treatment with specialized staff and equipment.
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PrescriptionExposure: Prescription Exposure — Disclosing information about medications prescribed to individuals, including drug names, dosages, or pharmacy records.
  Siblings: Medical Record Exposure, Diagnosis Exposure
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000055: Healthcare Facility — A Facility that is designed for the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.
  Siblings: Maintenance Facility, Entertainment Facility, Training Camp

axes.rationale: The risk centers around the model providing advice related to pharmaceuticals, making 'pharmaceutical' a relevant object.
The risk involves the model potentially giving advice on drug administration, making 'drug administration' a relevant agent.
